summary.text: Luck Suppression Heavenly Palace is an Immortal Gu House Giant Sun Immortal Venerable hid in immemorial black heaven. It is named with Calamity Luck Altar and Eighty-Eight True Yang Building as one of the three houses he owned in life.

claims.text: South Desolation Immortal leads Yao Huang through immemorial black heaven and completes an immortal killer move that reveals a grand dark gold palace. Yao Huang recognizes it at once and grows agitated naming Luck Suppression Heavenly Palace. He asks what Giant Sun Immortal Venerable intended by stationing the house there, then follows South Desolation Immortal inside.

Deviation (recorded): this page is filed under gu-houses because Luck Suppression Heavenly Palace is a named Immortal Gu House. It is a mobile house stationed in black heaven, not a five-region map seat.

Inside the hall Yao Huang meets Giant Sun Immortal Venerable as an immortal zombie with remnant will in the corpse, not a living main body. The zombie says he set Luck Suppression Heavenly Palace here to defend Northern Plains, while leaving the body for another reason: to return a favor. South Desolation Immortal later tells Yao Huang that Luck Suppression Heavenly Palace is a rank eight Immortal Gu House Giant Sun created personally using the heaven and earth luck true inheritance, and that it has suppressed this area for three hundred thousand years. He explains that every life form has luck, that rocks and rivers have luck, and that heaven and earth themselves have heaven luck and earth luck, which that true inheritance researches and changes.

Through the rank eight house, Yao Huang can watch the experiences of Central Continent’s three Immortal Gu Houses in black heaven. He says Luck Suppression Heavenly Palace affects the luck of heaven and earth, and that it can interfere with directions of lightning storms in immemorial black heaven that even heaven’s will cannot affect. South Desolation Immortal adds that after three hundred thousand years on station, the palace has deeply affected immemorial black heaven and even influenced immemorial white heaven, calling that the supreme power of heaven and earth luck.

Luck Suppression Heavenly Palace has one great weakness: it must stay in place, and moving it even a hairsbreadth would destroy the three hundred thousand years of effort behind its hold over Northern Plains’ black and white heaven.
